finalText:
**Migration done.** Converted 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

| Package | Files |
|---|---|
| analytics | `cohort.js` |
| orders | `returnService.js`, `shipment.js` |
| billing | `refund.js`, `couponService.js` |
| support | `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js` |
| catalog | `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js` |
| accounts | `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js` |

One holdout remains: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js:9,13`. Its header says it's vendored and overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, so I left it alone — fixing it there would be lost on the next bump. That leaves `lib/db.js`'s `query` as still reachable through the vendored ORM.
